newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Tuesday, due mainly to short-covering by private investors as the dollar posted modest gains against the yen later in the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.7 yen to 2.4 yen per kg firmer. Most-active benchmark July was up 2.4 yen at 148.3 yen.

"In addition to the yen's fall, the rise in the margin requirement on the February contract effective from Wednesday prompted investors to cover shorts, especially in nearby months," one trader said. He added that local investors were still wary of fresh buying.
